dedupe_keys.name: alphabuilding synthetic buildings operation dataset lbnl oedi

description: AlphaBuilding is a synthetic building operation dataset from Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory with HVAC, lighting and miscellaneous electric load operating conditions, occupant counts, environmental parameters, and end-use and whole-building energy use at 10-minute intervals. It comes from 1,395 annual simulations of the U.S. DOE medium office reference building with 30 years of historical weather for Miami, San Francisco and Chicago and three levels of building and system efficiency, using assumptions on occupant movement, diverse temperature preferences, lighting and plug loads to mimic realistic operation; metadata use the Brick schema. The whole dataset is a 1.2 TB compressed HDF5 file, with a GitHub page and exploration notebook. Coverage: one prototype building type in three US climates. Access: free on OEDI (published December 2020, DOI 10.25984/1784722). Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: synthetic data from a single prototype, very large to download. Simulation uses: benchmarking load shapes, calibrating energy models, and developing load prediction, model predictive control and reinforcement learning controllers. Related records: the Google Smart Buildings dataset, the Brick schema and EnergyPlus.
